title: у + genitive: near, at, by (also shows possession)

blocks.text: **у** takes the **genitive** case: near, at, by (also shows possession).

items: in the possession of (used to express "to have")
belonging to (used to denote ownership of body parts or appendages of objects)
How much time do you have?

blocks.text: Meanings and examples: Wiktionary, «у» (en.wiktionary.org, CC BY-SA 4.0). Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Острота слуха у ___ (собака, gen. sg.) намного выше, чем у человека.
exercises.prompt: The hearing acuity of dogs is superior by far to that of humans.
exercises.why: **собака → собаки** (gen. sg.). Declines like сестра. Ending -а → -и.

exercises.q: У ___ (я, gen. sg.) слюнки текут, когда я читаю кулинарные книги.
exercises.prompt: My mouth waters when I read cooking books.
exercises.why: **я → меня** (gen. sg.).  After a preposition the third-person pronouns take н-: у него, к ней, с ними.  — forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: У ___ (человек, gen. pl.) было бы больше автономии, будь у них работа.
exercises.prompt: People would have more autonomy if they had a job.
exercises.why: **человек → людей** (gen. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural люди. The stem changes too, so no single ending is given.

exercises.q: У ___ (мы, gen. pl.) и в мыслях не было так обхуесосить оппонентов.
exercises.prompt: We didn't mean to disparage our contenders.
exercises.why: **мы → нас** (gen. pl., agreeing with и). «мы» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (pl.):

exercises.q: У этого ___ (телевизор, gen. sg.) плохое изображение. Оно мелькает.
exercises.prompt: The picture on this TV is no good. It keeps flickering.
exercises.why: **телевизор → телевизора** (gen. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -а.
